title: Equality of configuration codes
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. Let $x$ be a Boolean input of length $n$, and let $c,d$ be configurations of $M$ on input $x$, each with every work-tape head within distance $s$ of the origin and every work tape blank outside that range. Their Boolean codes are equal if and only if their core configurations are equal and their output summaries are equal.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean symbols
Both configurations have work-tape heads at absolute position at most $s$
Both configurations have blank work-tape cells at every position of absolute value greater than $s$
